title: Rebuild Ops from a clean Base snapshot
goal: Replace the historical file-by-file foundation consumer with a deterministic clean rebuild: a complete Pantheon Base snapshot plus an explicitly declared Ops business overlay.

in: preserve business/{bizscope,cmdb,deploy}, business smoke, business design docs, and Ops repository governance
keep Base repository layout and Go module identity in the rebuilt product tree
generate backend/frontend module, component, menu component, and business fallback registries from one manifest
prove the rebuild is deterministic and contains no undeclared generic product overlay
validate in a temporary tree before replacing the current Ops baseline
out: new business behavior, schema, or UI design
Base product changes or another Base patch release
retaining historical shared-source drift merely because it exists in the old Ops tree

syncExpectation: Consume the locked pantheon-base snapshot plus business-overlay.json; the rebuilt tree must be byte-for-byte reproducible and free of undeclared generic product overlay.
